title: CFTCG: Test Case Generation for Simulink Model through Code Based Fuzzing
problem: Simulink models for embedded controllers face challenges achieving high test coverage as complexity grows. Mainstream test case generation methods based on constraint solving and model simulation struggle to handle complex control logic and internal states.
motivation: Simulink is extensively used for embedded controller modeling and synthesis, making efficient and effective test case generation critical for system verification and safety.
method: CFTCG converts Simulink models (the visual blocks used to design embedded controllers) into code, then applies fuzzing—a technique that feeds random and semi-random inputs to code to explore its behavior—rather than using mathematical constraint solving or step-by-step model simulation. This approach explores complex control paths and internal state combinations that traditional constraint-solving methods often miss.
key_novelty: The core idea is applying code-based fuzzing (testing by feeding random inputs to code) to Simulink-generated code for test case generation, instead of constraint solving or simulation.
contributions: Code-based fuzzing methodology for Simulink model test case generation
Improved test coverage metrics over constraint solving and simulation approaches
Effective handling of complex control logic and internal model states

metrics.other: test coverage improvement over baseline methods

primary_theme: code-based fuzzing for Simulink test generation
